content: Bhyoḥ! Glorious Goddess, you who are difficult to fathom,You engage in the magical displays of skillful means to the very edges of space.To you, who are the emanation of a Bodhisattva,I prostrate with devotion of body, speech, and mind.Although you are not obscured by my offerings,In order to attain the supreme and glorious accomplishment,I rain down a shower of the qualities of desire into the sky;May this collection of offerings cause your faculties to flourish.Glorious one, you are the witness to virtue and non-virtue;The entire accumulation of my faults of body, speech, and mind,I confess fully before you with deep regret;By the power of your compassion, please purify these obscurations.Your distinction is completely supreme,Perfectly accomplishing the benefit of beings and my own welfare;With joy and without envy,I offer this rejoicing to your mental continuum.O supreme body endowed with authentic qualities,Wearing the attire of the black, the beautiful, and the wrathful,For the sake of the benefit of beings throughout the ten directions and three times,I pray that you manifest in the manner of a net of magical illusion.In this way, O supreme body endowed with authentic qualities,For the sake of the benefit of beings and to protect the teachings,Until the reaches of space are exhausted,I pray that you do not pass into nirvana but remain forever.Through this virtue of prostrating, offering, confessing,Rejoicing, exhorting, and praying,May the lower realms be emptied,And may I dedicate everything for the sake of enlightenment.
